workPrinciples.title: We hire with our own product
workPrinciples.body: Every role has a rubric before it opens, and you can ask to see how you were scored.

workPrinciples.title: Three hubs, flexible weeks
workPrinciples.body: Teams sit in Amsterdam, Bengaluru and Austin. Most people are in the office two or three days a week.

workPrinciples.title: Small teams, real ownership
workPrinciples.body: Squads of five to eight own a product area end to end, including the customer calls.

workPrinciples.title: Time to get better
workPrinciples.body: A learning budget, internal talks every fortnight and two hack weeks a year.

benefits: Competitive salary with equity for every role
Health cover for you and your family
25 days of leave plus local public holidays
Paid parental leave for all parents

hiringSteps.title: Apply
hiringSteps.body: Send a resume. No cover letter needed. You hear back within five working days.

hiringSteps.title: Skills task
hiringSteps.body: A short, role-specific exercise on our own assessment product, done when it suits you.

hiringSteps.title: Structured interview
hiringSteps.body: The same questions for every candidate, scored on the rubric published with the role.

hiringSteps.title: Meet the team
hiringSteps.body: A conversation with the people you would work with. Bring your own questions.

hiringSteps.title: Offer
hiringSteps.body: A written offer within two days of the decision, with feedback whatever the outcome.
